schema.workerCountMax: Optional Swarm team-size override (positive integer). Leave unset to inherit the running DSH subagents maxActiveSubagents. Does not reserve or bypass native capacity.
schema.claimTtlMs: How long a claim finding stays in live views and pushed notices (milliseconds, 1 minute to 7 days, default 1 hour). Expired claims remain in history and search; a claim is an announcement, not a lock.

meta.title: Swarm · Peer collaboration
